items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the Bhote Koshi floods, search teams have recovered 734 bodies and rescued over 8,000 people. Nearly 2,500 remain missing, including more than 400 foreign nationals.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, and teams have rescued more than 4450 people so far, including over 187 foreigners. About 2400 remain unaccounted for, with 626 bodies recovered.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with 511 out of 632 people from 33 countries still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: A mudslide hit Gyirong Port yesterday morning, killing three people and leaving 558 others missing. Rescue teams and helicopters are now at the site, along with tents, food, and other supplies for those affected.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River yesterday, washing away homes, roads and bridges. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 people from 33 countries remain missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal's foreign ministry has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals caught in the Rasuwa flash floods. Families can reach them on +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India’s external affairs ministry has opened a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Phone, WhatsApp, and email contacts are listed for anyone who needs to reach them or the Indian embassies in Kathmandu and Beijing.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River this morning, killing people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals hit by the flash floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi areas. Families can contact the MEA control room in Delhi at +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719 or WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or the embassy on +977-9851316807.
items.citation: Embassy of India, Kathmandu
